_provenance.server: plexscratch42 (PMS 1.42.2), measured 2026-10-01 by cycle 87 agent e3
_provenance.items: A, B = two unwatched movies of 1 800 690 ms (ratingKey 3, 5), C = one of 1 800 012 ms (2), X (queue_selection) = a 20 011 ms movie no queue holds (299). P = a fresh dumb playlist of A, B (3 600 000 ms), created before and deleted after each pl* sequence.
_provenance.shapes: web = Plex Web 4.160.0's beat as plexlab's c45-play-mp4 capture holds it (ratingKey, key, playbackTime, playQueueItemID, state, hasMDE, time, duration, every X-Plex-* in the query, X-Plex-Session-Identifier last); pa = python-plexapi 4.18 Playable.updateTimeline (ratingKey, key, identifier, time, state, duration) with its headers, the client identifier being the session.
_provenance.setup: Before every sequence one play queue of A, B, C (or of P for pl_*) is created by Plex Web client c87e3-web; beats 0.6 s apart; afterwards A, B, C unscrobbled and every new history row deleted.
_provenance.spec: [session tag, state, time (int ms | float = fraction of the item | "P0.92" = fraction of the playlist), item label (A/B/C/P), playQueueItemID (A/B/C = that queue row, omit = absent, none = empty, abc, zero = 0, bogus = 999999), extra {client: override X-Plex-Client-Identifier, queue_read: GET the queue after}]
_provenance.answer: status, playbackState, viewCount, viewOffset of the timeline response; selected = the queue selection read right after (row label).
_provenance.redaction: No token is recorded; machine identifiers appear only in the queue-create uri, which is not kept.
